page.layout: One scan: the front board of a leather binding, blind-tooled with an ornamental frame and a central oval medallion. No printed text block.
page.notes: This scan shows a tooled leather book cover, not a printed page. The only lettering is embossed on the oval medallion: a band along the top arc that appears to read "...VON GOTTES", with further letters around the lower arc, too worn and shadowed to read reliably. Since this is blind-tooled decoration rather than printed text, nothing is transcribed. Dark stains and abrasion mark the board.
